questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Reading – Factual Passage. which detail should be used when answering a factual question from a passage?

options.A: A guess based on the title
options.B: Information explicitly stated in the passage

questions.explanation: Factual questions require evidence stated in the given passage.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Reading – Vocabulary. the word “resilient” most nearly means:
questions.explanation: Resilient describes the ability to recover or adapt after adversity.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Grammar – Tenses. choose the correct option: “They ____ for the bus since 8 a.m.”
questions.explanation: Present perfect continuous describes an activity continuing from the past until now.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Grammar – Clauses. identify the subordinate clause: “I stayed indoors because it was raining.”
questions.explanation: The because-clause depends on the main clause and gives the reason.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Grammar – Editing. choose the correction: “Each of the players have a kit.”

options.A: Each of the players has a kit.
options.B: Each of the players are a kit.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Writing – Article. an effective article introduction should:

options.A: Introduce the topic and engage the reader

questions.explanation: An introduction establishes the subject and gives readers a reason to continue.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Writing – Speech. a speech to students about digital safety should normally include:

options.A: A greeting, clear points and a suitable closing

questions.explanation: A speech is audience-focused and follows a clear opening, body and conclusion.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Literature – Prose. a theme in a literary text is best described as:

options.B: A central idea explored through the text

questions.explanation: Theme is the underlying idea or concern developed by the work.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Literature – Poetry. a group of lines in a poem is called a:
questions.explanation: A stanza is a grouped set of poetic lines.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Literature – Poetry. a contrast between expectation and reality may create:
questions.explanation: Irony often arises when the outcome differs from what is expected.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Vocabulary. choose the synonym of “benevolent”.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Grammar – Determiners. choose the correct phrase: “There are ____ chairs for everyone.”
questions.explanation: Enough is used with plural countable nouns to indicate sufficiency.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Grammar – Passive Voice. choose the passive form: “The committee approved the plan.”

options.B: The plan was approved by the committee.
options.C: The plan is approving by committee.
options.D: The committee was approved by the plan.

questions.explanation: Past simple active changes to was/were + past participle in passive voice.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Writing – Email. a formal email subject line should be:
questions.explanation: A concise subject helps the recipient understand the purpose.

questions.subject: English Communicative
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Comprehension – Evaluation. which response best evaluates an author’s argument?

options.A: It is good because I agree
options.B: It considers the claim, evidence and reasoning

questions.explanation: Evaluation examines the quality of claims and supporting evidence.
